source: Notion kit PTDH v0.1 via docs/reports/qbd-core-p2-autodraft/agent-map.json (target sections and kinds are an engineering inference, not stated by the kit)

agents.name: Input Validator
agents.notes: Kit says not in SOP; system convention. Checks max_actives.

agents.name: Report Assembler
agents.notes: Depends on all waves; reuses 12.1 result, does not re-score.

agents.name: Loop Controller
agents.notes: Loops only if gap fillable from Kho or user data; > max_review_loops asks user (default 1).

agents.name: Dosage Form Classifier
agents.notes: Non immediate-release tablet groups flagged NGOAI SOP.

agents.name: Knowledge Base Connector
agents.notes: Fail-closed for group C or unclassified.

agents.name: Wave Scheduler and Merger
agents.notes: Runs at end of each wave. Sequential fallback in wave then ascending ID must give same result.

agents.name: Combination Planner
agents.notes: Only for combinations. combo_without_rmp: stop and report.

agents.name: Active Identity Resolver
agents.notes: Multiple candidates: stop and ask user.

agents.name: API Data Collector
agents.notes: Per active. Unsourced value is CAN DU LIEU.

agents.name: RMP Profiler
agents.notes: Per active; combination needs RMP of exact combination. No formula guessing.

agents.name: Experimental-Stability Data Intake
agents.notes: Per active; rerun on new data. First run with no data writes prioritized gaps.

agents.name: CTD Mapper
agents.notes: Runs if market EU or Both.

agents.name: ACTD Mapper
agents.notes: Runs if market Domestic or Both. App.I in Kho is a DRAFT; final section count pending.

agents.name: Dual-Market Reconciler
agents.notes: Only for market Both. No merging unless SOP allows.

agents.name: RMP Describer
agents.notes: Conflicting sources: state and justify choice.

agents.name: QTPP Builder
agents.notes: SOP does not list QTPP attributes; ICH Q8(R2) once loaded to Kho.

agents.name: CQA Builder
agents.notes: No CQA beyond library unless sourced; proposals go to 3.5. Opens gate 3.5.

agents.name: Dosage-Form CQA Library
agents.notes: N2-N9 tagged NGOAI SOP.

agents.name: CQA Confirmation Gate
agents.notes: Not in SOP. Blocks 4.4, wave 3+. CQA change after A4/A5 ran: 0.7 computes rerun set. Never self-confirm.

agents.name: API Properties
agents.notes: Per active. BCS/solubility decide A7; physchem decides A5. 1.3 is an input but not in depends_on. ACTD needs less than EU.

agents.name: Excipient Selector
agents.notes: Per active. N5-N9: Kho lacks internal docs, write CAN DU LIEU. ACTD not required for generic.

agents.name: Compatibility Studies
agents.notes: Per active. No data: no compatibility conclusion.

agents.name: Initial Risk Assessment
agents.notes: Waits for gate 3.5 though 3.5 is not in depends_on. Missing data is CAN DU LIEU, never default Low. Feeds 6.1a.

agents.name: API-API Interaction Assessor
agents.notes: Only if is_combination = yes; depends on all per-active 4.1. Not in SOP.

agents.name: Direct Compression Assessor
agents.notes: No numeric thresholds. Refinement (after 4.1) awaits R&D head confirmation.

agents.name: Granulation Assessor
agents.notes: Same as 5.1.

agents.name: Rationale Writer
agents.notes: Outside N1,N2: only scope + gap. Final decision belongs to project.

agents.name: Formulation Risk Assessment (initial)
agents.notes: 6.1 split into 6.1a/6.1b for the scheduler.

agents.name: Formulation Studies
agents.notes: Records user data as is; creates no results. DOE only if project chooses.

agents.name: Overage Evaluator
agents.notes: Mandatory for all markets. No data: "chua co du lieu", not "no overage".

agents.name: Final Formula and Roles
agents.notes: Feeds A9, A10. 4.2 is an input but only transitive.

agents.name: Multi-strength Strategy
agents.notes: Only if >= 2 strengths. SOP gives no criteria; no self-set. Strength-specific outline leaves exist; mapping to them not stated.

agents.name: BCS and ICH M9 Eligibility
agents.notes: Dosage form outside M9 scope: stop and ask.

agents.name: Comparative Dissolution Gate
agents.notes: Valid only with user data. Must use the same similarity method as 8.2 although it does not depend on 8.1/8.2.

agents.name: Route: Miễn BE hoặc Kế hoạch BE
agents.notes: Runs before 8.5. Mismatch 7.3 vs 8.2: report and ask user.

agents.name: Dissolution Method Developer
agents.notes: No parameters without data.

agents.name: Comparative Dissolution
agents.notes: f2 computed only from user data; criteria from cited official doc (SOP sets no threshold).

agents.name: Other Dosage Form Properties
agents.notes: Outline also has strength-specific leaves P.2.2.3.3.2, P.2.2.3.3.3; mapping not stated.

agents.name: BE-Biowaiver Conclusion Writer
agents.notes: Must follow 7.4; mismatch is reported to 12.3. Outline has no BE leaf.

agents.name: Process Risk and Environment Control
agents.notes: No self-set humidity/temperature ranges. Runs first in A9 (chain 9.1-9.4).

agents.name: Unit Operation Developer
agents.notes: Operation list comes from 5.3 and user data; outside N1,N2 is NGOAI SOP, ask user.

agents.name: Scale-up
agents.notes: No extrapolation of parameters.

agents.name: CPP Proposer
agents.notes: Proposal only; R&D head confirms. Feeds 11.3.

agents.name: Advanced QbD Module
agents.notes: Optional; never self-enabled. Depends on user decision. Commercial design space belongs to P.3.

agents.name: Container Closure
agents.notes: No stability data: no conclusion.

agents.name: Microbiological Attributes
agents.notes: Never blank. N5-N9 NGOAI SOP.

agents.name: Compatibility
agents.notes: Runs in wave 1; needs no final formula. Market input from A2 is not in depends_on.

agents.name: Stability Link
agents.notes: Runs after 10.1. No shelf life without data.

agents.name: Process Link
agents.notes: Does not write commercial process.

agents.name: Control Strategy Link
agents.notes: Proposal only.

agents.name: Interchangeability Link
agents.notes: Kit says dependency "A2" (skill level); 2.1/2.2 are my inference.

agents.name: Self-check Phụ lục C
agents.notes: Item 15 vs A2 frame, item 16 via 12.4, item 17 via 12.3. Item 11 N/A only with reason.

agents.name: QA/QC Reviewer
agents.notes: Machine pre-review only; GMP criteria NGOAI SOP.

agents.name: Consistency Checker
agents.notes: Checks 7.4 vs 8.5, 7.3 vs 8.2 method, CQA-change reruns, per-active branches. Reports, never fixes.

agents.name: Evidence Tracer
agents.notes: Unconfirmed SOP v01 or product-specific values count as untraceable. External source needs full citation.
